shortDescription: MISSISSAUGA, Ontario, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Next Hydrogen Solutions Inc. (“Next Hydrogen” or the “Company”) TSXV:NXH announces its intention to complete a proposed restructuring of its outstanding 10.0% unsecured convertible debentures (the “Debentures”) originally issued on December 12…

children: announces its intention to complete a proposed restructuring of its outstanding 10.0% unsecured convertible debentures (the “
”) originally issued on December 12, 2024 pursuant to a non-brokered private placement of 2,725 Debentures for aggregate gross proceeds of $2,725,000.

The Debentures will mature on December 12, 2026 and bear interest at a rate of 10.0% per annum payable semi-annually. The principal amount of the Debentures is convertible into common shares of the Company (the “

”) at a conversion price of $1.00 per Common Share. The Company previously converted an aggregate principal amount of $1,125,000 of the Debentures into Common Shares on December 17, 2025. As a result, an aggregate principal amount of $1,600,000 of the Debentures remains outstanding (the “
The Company proposes to satisfy a portion of the Outstanding Debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $450,000 by cash payment (the “
”) and, to extend the maturity date of the balance of the Outstanding Debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $1,150,000 (the “
Details of the Cash Repayment and Proposed Extension
In connection with the Proposed Extension, holders of the Remaining Debentures will surrender their existing Debentures and receive replacement convertible debentures (the “

”) having substantially the same terms as the existing Debentures, including a 10.0% annual interest rate, a conversion price of $1.00 per Common Share, unsecured status and subordination to senior indebtedness, except for the revised maturity date. The Proposed Extension will apply equally to all holders of the Remaining Debentures. Other than the extension of the maturity date, all material terms of the Replacement Debentures will remain unchanged.
The Proposed Extension is intended to provide the Company with additional financial flexibility while continuing to advance commercialization activities and support its ongoing business objectives.
The Company expects the Cash Repayment and the Proposed Extension to be completed on or about December 12, 2026.

Completion of the Proposed Extension is subject to certain conditions including, but not limited to, the receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals including the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange (the “

”), participation by holders of the Remaining Debentures, and the finalization and execution of definitive agreements. As such, there can be no assurance that the Proposed Extension will be completed on the terms described herein or at all.

This press release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any of the securities in the United States. The securities have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “

”) or any state securities laws and may not be offered or sold within the United States or to U.S. persons unless registered under the U.S. Securities Act and applicable state securities laws or an exemption from such registration is available.

Founded in 2007, Next Hydrogen is a designer and manufacturer of electrolyzers that use water and electricity to generate clean hydrogen for use as a clean energy source. Next Hydrogen’s unique cell design architecture supported by over 40 patents enables superior dynamic response to efficiently convert intermittent renewable electricity into green hydrogen on a commercial infrastructure scale.
